title: objectql: an extend layer's record-mode currency amount is judged against the object as served, so a bad follow pair is refused at the run that completes it (not at a later no-change upgrade of the parent)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czXwx6JtQPvacrzzUw

Split from #32934 item 2 (os-dev report 6887729320, measured on main by area E2b). Area-lease pilot #33059, lease:E2b. The seat ruling below was reviewed once before filing.

## Premise (measured)
A package that only EXTENDS an object can add a record-mode currency amount that follows:
- a parent field with no ISO 4217 code,
- a missing field, or
- a field reached through its own new master_detail.

All three are ADMITTED. `recordCurrencyFollowRefusalOf` (registry.ts) passes `partial: ownership === 'extend'`, and `recordCurrencyFollowRefusal` (record-currency-aggregate-door.ts) returns before the follow and other-ends halves. The bad amount is then served, and a later no-change upgrade of the parent's owner is refused 422 on the extension's field, which blames the wrong package. Controls: the same amount in an own object body gets 422; installing parent and extension together gets 422. Run end, the batch writer (batch-object-registration.ts) and single save share this path.

## Ruling: A, amended
- **R1:** every layer is judged as the served fold of its object (base + enabled extensions + the incoming body), never as the partial body.
- **R2:** if the extended object is not registered, there is no verdict (unchanged).
- **R3:** the run that completes a bad pair is refused, whichever end it holds. No order is exempt. This includes an extension registered before its object's owner, so the owner's own-body loop and the other-ends check also read the served extensions.
- **R4:** an extension that arrives before the parent's code field exists is refused, the same as an own body.
- **R5:** cross-extension: the followed field is read from the served parent. A missing or disabled supplier means refusal; the same artifact passes at run end.
- **R6:** a parent upgrade that removes or de-codes a followed field is refused, because the upgrade is the breaking change. The message names the extension's package and field.
- **R7:** a no-change upgrade is never refused.

## Acceptance
- Clause-② table: every moved answer FROM→TO, in both registration orders, at run end, in the batch writer, and on single save.
- CONTROLs: an own body, and parent + extension installed together.
- Pin, or file separately, whether uninstalling or disabling a supplier extension (R5) and enabling a package ask the door.
- `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` goes to contract review. Add a minor changeset line. No legacy-data migration or heal (maintainer, 2026-11-14: no production customers yet).

## Files
- packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts
- packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (shared file; check open PRs from A4 and E1 first)
- packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts (header prose only; E1 owns this file, so coordinate with E1)
- Tests beside manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts, plus batch-writer tests.
